reviews.shade: K-SECRET Instant Relief Eye Gel Patch (Caffeine) 60 Patches
reviews.text: I see a notable tightening of my skin especially my underbags everytime I use these. I am an artist that is often in front of cameras, and I make sure to use this before my make up before every shoot to appear younger and more rested.
reviews.zh: 每次用完都明顯感覺到皮膚收緊咗，尤其係眼底嘅眼袋。我係一個成日要面對鏡頭嘅演藝工作者，每次影相之前都一定會搽咗呢個再化妝，等自己睇落後生啲、精神啲。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Instant Relief Eye Gel Patch (Caffeine) 60 Patches
reviews.text: Неплохие патчи для глаз мне нравится размер и форма удобные по эффекту средние но им есть место на полке
reviews.zh: 眼貼唔錯，我鍾意佢嘅尺寸同形狀，貼合舒服；效果方面只係一般，但都仲有佢嘅存在價值。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Instant Relief Eye Gel Patch (Caffeine) 60 Patches
reviews.text: Perhaps the best thing about this brand of eye patch is the size! It’s about twice the size of a regular eye patch. In addition, I definitely noticed a difference with puffy eye bags immediately after using it. I regret only buying one as when I tried to repurchase it again, they are sold out!
reviews.zh: 呢個品牌嘅眼貼最大賣點可能就係尺寸！大概係普通眼貼嘅兩倍大。除此之外，用完即刻感覺到對眼腫眼袋有好明顯嘅改善。早知就唔淨係買一盒，我之後想再買返已經售罄，好後悔！

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Instant Relief Eye Gel Patch (Caffeine) 60 Patches
reviews.text: Nice eye gel patches. I liked it that you have some extras that you can use on other areas of your face. However, I haven’t noticed significant improvement after using them. Still a nice treat though.
reviews.zh: 眼凝膠貼幾好用。我鍾意佢有附額外嘅貼可以用喺臉上其他位置。不過用完之後我唔覺得有顯著改善。算係一個唔錯嘅享受啦。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Instant Relief Eye Gel Patch (Caffeine) 60 Patches
reviews.text: I like that it had different sized patches, and it feels nice on the skin. Very hydrating, I notice my makeup does not crease as bad when I wear these. If I leave them on too long, sometimes the product pills, so make sure not to wear it longer than 30 min
reviews.zh: 我鍾意佢有唔同尺寸嘅眼貼，貼住皮膚感覺好舒服。非常保濕，我留意到用咗之後化妝冇咁容易摺紋。如果貼太耐，有時會出現搓泥情況，所以記住唔好貼超過 30 分鐘。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Instant Relief Eye Gel Patch (Caffeine) 60 Patches
reviews.text: I love this eye patches the size is perfect to cover all your eye bags and you feel a lot of relief like a cool sensation that depuff your eye bags and helps you with your dark circles, the smell it’s also good.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款眼貼，尺寸啱啱好可以完全覆蓋成個眼袋，涼浸浸嘅感覺好舒服，可以消眼腫、改善黑眼圈，氣味都幾好。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Instant Relief Eye Gel Patch (Caffeine) 60 Patches
reviews.text: This are so pretty and delightful to use. They are twice as big as any other eye gel patch I've used before, which seems to really help with depuffing the whole area. The adhesion is also the best of any gel patch I've tried. Really pleased! I stuck them in the fridge and they feel amazing in the morning.
reviews.zh: 呢款眼貼好靚，用落好治癒。比我用過嘅任何其他眼凝膠貼大兩倍，對成個範圍消腫都明顯有幫助。貼服度亦係我用過嘅凝膠貼入面最好。用完真係好滿意！我將佢哋擺喺雪櫃，朝早用嘅時候感覺一流。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Instant Relief Eye Gel Patch (Caffeine) 60 Patches
reviews.text: I use these in the morning to help with getting rid of my sleepy eyes. Very moisturizing and gives a good glow! A little hard to get out of the container, be sure to use the tool provided so you only take out one at a time.
reviews.zh: 我朝早會用佢嚟急救「瞓捩眼」。非常保濕，仲會有健康嘅光澤！但係有少少難從容器攞出嚟，記住要用跟機提供嘅工具，一次過淨係攞一塊出嚟。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
